service.en: Open a domestic worker sponsorship file
service.ar: فتح ملف كفالة عامل خدمة منزلية
service.ur: گھریلو ملازم کی کفالت فائل کھولنا

about: An employer opens the file needed to bring in domestic workers.
note: Requirements read from the public TAMM service page on the checked date. The form itself sits behind UAE PASS sign-in, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

fees: AED 115 for citizens and GCC nationals
AED 215 for residents, investors and diplomats
channels: Sign in with UAE PASS on TAMM (website or app)
